A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study and support comparison of the text, equations, tables and appendices. Although v2 clips lower panels of Figure 23, all five panels remain embedded in the PDF and match v3, allowing complete comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original RNN experiments, LLM concept-decoding results, grafting/freezing interventions and supplementary analyses in Appendices D–F.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and their outcomes, including the TREC comparisons and quantitative intervention results.

M1.justification: DSC, PA and UCD retain their procedures, thresholds and objectives. The grafting/freezing definitions and Appendix C pseudocode are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic RNN sequences, word-decoding tasks, narrative schemas, ROCStories/TREC intervention scenarios and Emma/POS analyses. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The PA-versus-pretrained-SAE comparison remains unchanged in v2 Figure 3/v3 Figure 4. The trained/untrained RNN, intervention/control and input-versus-chunk grafting comparisons are also retained.

E3.justification: The reported models, splits, prompts, thresholds and metrics are unchanged. Both versions retain 2,000 ROCStories sentences, 50 TREC prompts per category and the same early, middle and late grafting layer groups.

E4.justification: Appendices D–F retain the RNN architecture checks, trained/untrained comparisons, context-sensitivity analysis, chunk-quality diagnostics and K=500–8000 sensitivity analysis. Relocated plots do not introduce new analyses.

E5.justification: Figure 12 still reports 10 independent runs with standard-error bars. The top-100-word plot also retains standard-error reporting in v2 Figure 4/v3 Figure 5. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All six tables retain their entries, and the matched figure image data are identical, including v2's clipped Figure 23 panels. For example, Table 3 reports cake occurrence at 1% without grafting and 83% with grafting in both versions.

T1.justification: The formal chunk definition, Strong Law of Large Numbers argument, equations 1–9 and intervention definitions are unchanged. Mathematical differences are confined to typesetting.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about the Reflection Hypothesis, concrete and abstract concept encoding, architectural applicability and causal effects of chunk interventions.

C2.justification: Interpretations of distributed representations, context dependence and weaker PA performance for ambiguous or function words remain unchanged. The limitations and future-work discussions are retained, including the reflowed Appendix F.6 paragraph.

D1.justification: v3 adds an explicit public implementation/code repository address below the abstract and at the start of the supplementary information. v2's disclosure refers to a submission ZIP and planned public release. Implementation and compute details remain unchanged; the old release checklist text persists.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix A and all 94 references retain the same works and research positioning. Bibliographic differences are typographic.

P1.justification: The under-review footer becomes NeurIPS 2025 conference text, and several appendix/figure references are updated. Apart from the code-access statements, substantive prose and section order are retained.

P2.justification: v2 Figure 7 moves into the main text as v3 Figure 1. Figure 23 receives a separate page, restoring its previously clipped lower panels. Figure 32 is reduced to share a page with Figure 30. Other figures reflow, while underlying graphics and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 restores visible access to all Figure 23 panels and supplies an explicit public code location, improving presentation and reproducibility information. Moving the chunking illustration beside the method also helps readers. These limited gains outweigh the smaller Figure 32 and unrevised release checklist; the scientific evidence and conclusions remain unchanged.
